# Tab Panel

`@kerfjs/ui:wa-tab-panel` · Web Awesome · component · Navigation · recommendation: conditional

## When to use

Ecosystem tab panel; prefer app-owned panels with Kerf navigation.

**Not when:**

- Do not choose it from catalog presence alone; confirm that its semantic and interaction contract matches the product need.

**Alternatives:**

- [TabBar](./tab-bar.md) (prefer-kerf)

## Imports

- Theme CSS: import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` once.
- Registration: import `@awesome.me/webawesome/dist/components/tab-panel/tab-panel.js` once (a side effect).
- Custom element: `<wa-tab-panel>`.
- Declared side effects: custom-element-registration.

## Props

Typed JSX attributes: [`webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md`](../webawesome-jsx-signatures-v1.md) (import `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome` for types only). Use the Web Awesome attribute API; do not reach into its shadow DOM.

## Composition

- Parents: any.
- Contexts: `application-ui`.
- Children: unrestricted.

## State and wiring

No wiring helper.

## Geometry

Margin: none · border: none · padding: conditional (layout role: navigation). `self` means the component already owns it — do not add wrapper padding, margin, or borders around it.

- Container-mode tab panels own the themed container inset; uncontained panels do not.

## Accessibility

No component-specific obligations beyond native semantics and a visible or accessible name for every control.

## Styling boundary

The component owns its own styles. Configure it through its props and variants; do not override its internals.

Theme it only through `@kerfjs/ui/webawesome.css` and cataloged tokens. Do not restyle its shadow DOM or uncataloged `::part()` targets (`KUI-L011`).
